title: Reuters Raises the Jensen Huang Affair Tally to Three
content:
Reuters:

Ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an intimate relationship with a second employee, according to two people familiar ​with the matter, Reuters has ​learned.

The revelation follows two other extramarital affairs that led to his resignation ​Thursday. The two women are Alice Huang, ​who US intelligence suspects of being a Chinese spy, and Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice ​president of health care.

Reuters is not ​naming the second employee. Attempts to reach the woman were not successful.

What’s the over-under at? If it’s 4.5, I’ll take the over.

 ★
author: John Gruber
